theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (G : Euclid m → Euclid P) (F : Set (Euclid m)), MeasurableSet F → (∀ v ∈ F, DifferentiableAt ℝ G v) → (∀ v ∈ F, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ G v)) → InjOn G F → ∀ h : Euclid P → ℝ, ∫ w in G '' F, h w ∂μHE[m] = ∫ v in F, Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin m => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ G v (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ G v (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)))) * h (G v)
